entries.title: Update Infinitary on your other computers
entries.body: This version changes how your computers work together. A computer that runs work for you takes no new work until it runs this version too, and you can update it from Devices. A computer that controls your first mate can look but not change anything until it is updated.
entries.noPicture: This changes which versions of Infinitary work together, not the layout or words of a screen.

exclusions.reason: Release review for the alpha after 0.5.0-alpha.5: ranks minimizing a card, lighting a task everywhere and the protocol 10 update as highlights; rewords the minimize and merge-wait notes; adds the protocol 10 update note, which its change did not cover. Nothing in the app changes.
Code comments only: two comments now say a device download link lasts thirty minutes. Nothing in the app changes.
